{{Quote|Of all the crummy places in this port, why did you choose this one?''"<br />"''Well, I ''do'' know the owner. He owes me for a bet we once made. I get to eat and drink here for free whenever I'm in town.''"<br />"''Oh, boy. What a thrill that must be. You ever try to eat anything in this place?''"<br />"''I haven't been that hungry yet, no.|Princess Leia Organa and Lando Calrissian|<ref name="Shadows of the Empire (novel)">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>}}
A sleazy '''cantina''' operated business in the [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] by [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]]. [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] members [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] rendezvoused there once in that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].
